offering_description.value: Provides diagnostic imaging to patients at outpatient centers. Imaging technologists perform the scans, and radiologists interpret the results for referring clinicians.

primary_services.value: MRI; CT and PET/CT; ultrasound; X-ray; mammography

customer_segment.value: B2C: Patients referred for diagnostic imaging or seeking screening

end_markets.value: outpatient healthcare; orthopedics; oncology; women's health

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Commercial insurers and government health programs reimburse covered imaging procedures; service fees: Patients pay directly for self-pay scans

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses imaging equipment and clinical staff to provide scans for patients and reports for referring clinicians; asset operator: Operates outpatient facilities equipped with scanners to serve referred and screening patients

geography_served.value: US regional: Selected states in the South and Mountain West, including Texas, Georgia, Arizona and Colorado

specialization.value: niche specialist: Outpatient diagnostic imaging across multiple scanning modalities

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated outpatient imaging centers; other: Referrals from primary care clinicians and specialists

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Imaging facilities face state licensing and radiation-control rules, plus Medicare accreditation requirements for applicable advanced imaging services

notes: The exact state footprint of the centers Lumexa controls is uncertain.
